content: Intelligence is dangerous. Intelligence means you will start thinking on your own; you will start looking around on your own.
author: Osho
sourceWork: Meditation: The First and Last Freedom
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. True art and creative work are not about clever technique; they demand total emotional skin in the game. When you create safely to please an audience or avoid criticism, the work feels hollow and bloodless.

Osho understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Pouring your genuine spirit, vulnerability, and raw lived experience into what you make is what gives it enduring life. The work that resonates across centuries is always the work created with unapologetic personal truth.
reflectionPrompt: What would change in your daily outlook if you truly lived by this perspective?
